name: Blue-eyes White Dragon
desc: An extremely rare card with unsurpassed attack and defense power.

name: Mystical Elf
desc: A delicate elf that lacks in offense but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

name: Hitotsu-me Giant
desc: A one-eyed behemoth with thick, powerful arms made for delivering punishing blows.

name: Baby Dragon
desc: Much more than just a child, this dragon is gifted with untapped power.

name: Ryu-kishin
desc: A very elusive creature that looks like a harmless statue until it attacks.

name: Feral Imp
desc: A playful little imp that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.

name: Winged Dragon #1
desc: A dragon commonly found guarding mountain fortresses. Its signature attack is a sweeping dive from out of the blue.

name: Mushroom Man
desc: Found in moist areas, this monster launches poison spores against its enemies.

name: Shadow Specter
desc: Ghostly beast that appears in the wasteland and is particularly troublesome when faced in large numbers.

name: Blackland Fire Dragon
desc: A dragon that dwells in the depths of darkness. Its defensive capability suffers from its poor eyesight.

name: Sword Arm of Dragon
desc: With a body covered in sword-like thorns, nothing dares stand in the way of this monster when it charges.

name: Swamp Battleguard
desc: This creature is armed with a spiked club that can destroy almost anything in its path. Rumored to have a brother that is just as destructive.

name: Tyhone
desc: Capable of firing cannonballs from its mouth for long-range attacks against enemies.

name: Battle Steer
desc: A bull monster often found in the woods. Charges enemy monsters with a pair of razor-sharp horns.

name: Flame Swordsman
desc: A fighter gifted with the power of fire. Attacks enemies with a sword that launches flames.

name: Time Wizard
desc: A sorcerer capable of bending time to his will. Though not powerful at first glance, appearances can be deceiving.

name: Right Leg of the Forbidden One
desc: A forbidden limb sealed by magic. Whoever breaks this seal will know infinite power. Only one card of this type may be included in a deck.

name: Left Leg of the Forbidden One
desc: A forbidden limb sealed by magic. Whoever breaks this seal will know infinite power. Only one card of this type may be included in a deck.

name: Right Arm of the Forbidden One
desc: A forbidden limb sealed by magic. Whoever breaks this seal will know infinite power. Only one card of this type may be included in a deck.

name: Left Arm of the Forbidden One
desc: A forbidden limb sealed by magic. Whoever breaks this seal will know infinite power. Only one card of this type may be included in a deck.

name: Exodia the Forbidden
desc: Once combined with arms and legs, this monster is freed from its magical chains. Only one card of this type may be included in a deck.

name: Summoned Skull
desc: An entity with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the FIEND class of monsters, this is a pretty rare card.

name: The Wicked Worm Beast
desc: A monster worm created by the powers of darkness. It suddenly appears from under the ground to attack its enemies.

name: Skull Servant
desc: A skeletal ghost that isn't strong but can mean trouble in large numbers.

name: Horn Imp
desc: A small imp that dwells in the dark. Its single horn makes it a formidable opponent.

name: Battle Ox
desc: A monster with tremendous power. Destroys enemies with a swing of its axe.

name: Beaver Warrior
desc: What this creature lacks in size, it makes up for in defense when battling in the meadow.

name: Rock Ogre Grotto #1
desc: Protected by a solid body of rock, this creature throws a bone-shattering punch.

name: Mountain Warrior
desc: A solid warrior that can move swiftly over rough terrain.

name: Zombie Warrior
desc: A deceptively fragile-looking skeleton warrior that is known for its swift and precise attacks.

name: Koumori Dragon
desc: A vicious, fire-breathing dragon whose wicked flames corrupt the souls of its victims.

name: Two-headed King Rex
desc: An unusual and rarely seen two-headed dragon.

name: Judge Man
desc: For this club-wielding warrior, there is no other outcome to battle than victory or defeat.

name: Saggi the Dark Clown
desc: This clown appears out of nowhere and executes some very strange moves to avoid enemy attacks.

name: Dark Magician
desc: The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.

name: The Snake Hair
desc: A monster with the head of a poisonus snake. One look will turn an unwary opponent to stone.

name: Gaia the Dragon Champion
desc: A warrior's prowess combines with a dragon's speed to create a powerful offensive force.

name: Gaia the Fierce Knight
desc: A knight mounted on a horse that travels faster than the wind. His battle charge is a force to be reckoned with.

name: Curse of Dragon
desc: A wicked dragon that taps dark forces to execute a powerful attack.

name: Dragon Piper
desc: A jar carved with strange patterns. It has a particularly high defense factor.

name: Celtic Guardian
desc: An elf, who learned to wield a sword, baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

name: Illusionist Faceless Mage
desc: Manipulates enemy attacks with the power of illusion. A very rare card.

name: Karbonala Warrior
desc: A very average-looking fighter with an unusually high attack factor.

name: Rogue Doll
desc: A unique doll gifted with mystical power. Particularly powerful when attacking against dark forces.

name: Oscillo Hero #2
desc: Attacks its enemies with thunder.

name: Griffore
desc: This creature's tough hide deflects just about any attack.

name: Torike
desc: Not as tough as it looks in terms of defense. This monster's sharp horn gives it an edge when attacking.

name: Sangan
desc: A compact, three-eyed monster that is dangerous when faced in the dark.

name: Big Insect
desc: A giant ant that dwells in the jungle. Powerful in terms of both ATK and DEF factors.

name: Basic Insect
desc: Usually found travelling in swarms, this creature's ideal environment is the forest.

name: Armored Lizard
desc: A lizard with a very tough hide and a very vicious bite.

name: Hercules Beetle
desc: A massive beetle with a tough hide and a dangerous horn.

name: Killer Needle
desc: A huge bee with exceptional strength. Particularly dangerous when a swarm is encountered.

name: Gokibore
desc: A large, spherical roach that attacks its enemies by rolling over them. Its tough defense makes it a formidable foe.

name: Giant Flea
desc: A giant blood-sucking flea that's devastating when attacking.

name: Larvae Moth
desc: Not much in its larval form, this creature is a force to be reckoned with when it grows to become a colossal moth.

name: Great Moth
desc: A powerful creature of the forest, this huge moth attacks its enemies by spreading poison dust with its wings.

name: Kuriboh
desc: By itself, this small creature may not seem like much. But in the dark, it attacks in numbers as a formidable force.

name: Mammoth Graveyard
desc: A mammoth that protects the gravesite of its pack. It's absolutely merciless when facing graverobbers.

name: Great White
desc: A giant white shark with razor-sharp teeth.

name: Wolf
desc: A rarely seen wolf with a powerful nose for catching the scent of an enemy.

name: Harpie Lady
desc: A human-shaped animal with wings. Beautiful to watch, but lethal when engaged in battle.

name: Harpie Lady Sisters
desc: Three fierce sisters who relentlessly attack as a team.

name: Tiger Axe
desc: A fast and powerful axe-wielding beast warrior.

name: Silver Fang
desc: A snow wolf that's beautiful to the eye but absolutely vicious in battle.

name: Kojikocy
desc: A man-hunter with powerful arms that can crush boulders.

name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
desc: The final incarnation of the ultimate insect, the Great Moth!

name: Garoozis
desc: An axe-swinging beast warrior with the head of a dragon.

name: Thousand Dragon
desc: A dragon that has grown and developed over a thousand years.

name: Fiend Kraken
desc: A massive squid that suddenly appears from the depths of the sea to attack unwary enemies.

name: Jellyfish
desc: An almost invisible, semi-transparent jellyfish that drifts in the sea.

name: Cocoon of Evolution
desc: This creature is capable of instantly evolving larvae into adults.

name: Kairyu-shin
desc: A sea dragon that's referred to as the "King of the Ocean". It attacks its enemies with huge tidal waves.

name: Giant Soldier of Stone
desc: A giant warrior made of stone. A punch from this creature has earth-shaking results.

name: Man-eating Plant
desc: A meat-eating plant that is attractive to the eye but dangerous when approached.

name: Krokodilus
desc: A vicious crocodile with intelligence. Hard scales form a natural armor for this creature.

name: Grappler
desc: A devious snake with a thick body that wraps around an enemy monster and squeezes the life out of it.

name: Axe Raider
desc: An axe-wielding monster of tremendous strength and agility.

name: Megazowler
desc: Nothing stands in the way of this spike-covered dinosaur.

name: Uraby
desc: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

name: Crawling Dragon #2
desc: A powerful dragon with teeth that can grind almost anything to dust.

name: Red-eyes B. Dragon
desc: A very rare card with a high-level ATK factor.

name: Castle of Dark Illusions
desc: A creature that can generate darkness to envelop all that exists around it.

name: Reaper of the Cards
desc: This monster boasts a strong defense and a massive scythe that cuts through almost anything.

name: King of Yamimakai
desc: Wields the power of darkness to destroy its enemies.

name: Barox
desc: This creature flies through the dark, attacking its enemies with its long, hairy arms.

name: Dark Chimera
desc: A fire-breathing monster that dwells in the netherworld.

name: Metal Guardian
desc: A fiend guarding the treasures of the netherworld. Its defense is particularly high in a dark environment.

name: Catapult Turtle
desc: Well-protected by its shell, this monster flings projectiles from its catapult.

name: Gyakutenno Megami
desc: Uses her mystical power to protect the weak and provide spiritual support.

name: Mystic Horseman
desc: Half man and half horse, this monster is known for its extreme speed.

name: Rabid Horseman
desc: A powerful and unstoppable combination of bull and horse.

name: Zanki
desc: Prefers to face enemies one-on-one. His swiftly drawn blade delivers a quick and immediate finnish.

name: Crawling Dragon
desc: A weakened dragon that can no longer fly, but is still a formidable force to be reckoned with.

name: Crass Clown
desc: A performer in the Dark Circus, this clown drains the strength of its enemies with strange dances.

name: Armored Zombie
desc: A warrior raised from the beyond. Blindly swings a sharp blade with devastating force.

name: Dragon Zombie
desc: A dragon revived by sorcery. Its breath is highly corrosive.

name: Clown Zombie
desc: A clown revived by the powers of darkness. Its strange dance has sent many monsters to their ends.

name: Pumpking the King of Ghosts
desc: This pumpkin king strikes at its enemies with its long tentacles.

name: Battle Warrior
desc: A warrior that fights with his bare hands.

name: Wings of Wicked Flame
desc: Soaring over its enemies on wings of crimson fire, this monster attacks by blasting flames from its body.

name: Mask of Darkness
desc: A shadow mask created by the hands of a dark mage.

name: Job-change Mirror
desc: An indestructible, wicked mirror that blocks enemy attacks.

name: Curtain of the Dark Ones
desc: A curtain woven by the hands of a sorcerer. It is said to enhance the power of magic- users.

name: Tomozaurus
desc: A deceivingly small creature that is so vicious it attacks both friend and foe without discretion.

name: Spirit of the Winds
desc: A spirit of the wind that freely sails the skies. Known to generate storms when it's in a bad mood.

name: Kageningen
desc: Uses both its physical and shadow forms to attack, making it a difficult creature to overcome.

name: Graveyard and the Hand of Invitation
desc: A final resting place that enhances the power of the doomed and drains that of the living.

name: Goddess with the Third Eye
desc: A goddess with an all-seeing eye that reveals all.

name: Hero of the East
desc: A samurai from the Far East armed with a razor-sharp sword.

name: Doma The Angel of Silence
desc: This angel rules over the doomed and administers it when necessary.

name: That Which Feeds on Life
desc: A vile monster that fuels its power by draining the essence of life from its opponents.

name: Dark Gray
desc: Entirely gray, this beast has rarely been seen by mortal eyes.

name: White Magical Hat
desc: A gentleman thief that eludes the law despite the fact that he sticks out like a sore thumb with his silk hat and white cape.

name: Kamion Wizard
desc: A magic-user that controls chaos and wields a mighty sickle.

name: Nightmare Scorpion
desc: A very toxic creature that induces nightmares and attacks its victims with four poison- tipped stingers.

name: Spirit of the Books
desc: A spirit of the books with infinite knowledge and an endless variety of attack strategies.

name: Supporter in the Shadows
desc: A cute elf that assists against enemies while remaining hidden from sight.

name: Trial of Nightmares
desc: Passes judgment on enemies that are locked in coffins.

name: Dream Clown
desc: The mysterious dance of this creature draws its enemies into eternal slumber.

name: Sleeping Lion
desc: Frequently found sleeping, this monster is very dangerous when awakened.

name: Yamatano Dragon Scroll
desc: This dragon is conjured from a picture scroll to attack enemies. It has a pretty low defense factor.

name: Dark Plant
desc: A vicious flower raised from polluted soil and fertilized by dark forces.

name: Ancient Tool
desc: An engine of destruction discovered in the ruins of an ancient civilization.

name: Faith Bird
desc: A bird with a very long tail that attacks with a light that emanates from its entire being.

name: Orion the Battle King
desc: A mysterious creature known as the king of warriors, but nobody has lived long enough to tell how it earned its reputation.

name: Ansatsu
desc: A silent and swift warrior specializing in sneak attack.

name: LaMoon
desc: A sorcerer who lives on the moon and attacks opponents with the power of lunar light.

name: Nemuriko
desc: A child-like creature that controls a sleep spirit to beckon enemies into eternal slumber.

name: Weather Control
desc: This monster is capable of manipulating the weather. This power is the reason behind the changing climate of mountains.

name: Octoberser
desc: A strange creature with the head of a fish and the tentacles of an octopus that attacks its enemies with spears.

name: The 13th Grave
desc: A zombie that suddenly appeared from plot #13 - supposedly an empty grave.

name: Charubin the Fire Knight
desc: A warrior protected by a shell that can even deflect the heat of burning flames.

name: Mystical Capture Chain
desc: A mystical chain that is believed capable of binding its enemies and preventing their attacks.

name: Fiend's Hand
desc: Long arms reach out from the Swamp of Chaos to drag in enemy creatures.

name: Witty Phantom
desc: Dressed in a night-black tuxedo, this creature presides over the doomed.

name: Mystery Hand
desc: Twisting the fabric of reality, arms stretch out from another dimension to attack opponents.

name: Dragon Statue
desc: A granite warrior with a dragon's soul wields a powerful sword against all enemies.

name: Blue-eyed Silver Zombie
desc: A creature rumored to turn enemies into zombies with a strange ray that emanates from its eyes.

name: Toad Master
desc: Thousands of years old, this frog wizard attacks enemies with an army of tadpoles.

name: Spiked Snail
desc: Evolving from the powers of darkness, this snail has arms and legs that allow swift attacks against its enemies.

name: Flame Manipulator
desc: Attacks enemies with fire-related spells, such as the "Sea of Flames" and the "Wall of Fire".

name: Necrolancer the Timelord
desc: The first in a line of golems that appears almost anywhere from within a dimensional ring.

name: Djinn the Watcher of the Wind
desc: Controls the air currents to create violent winds and tornadoes to blow away its enemies.

name: The Bewitching Phantom Thief
desc: A flashy, black-caped thief who wields a magic cane.

name: Temple of Skulls
desc: A weird temple of skulls and bones that sucks the living essence of all those who dare approach it.

name: Monster Egg
desc: A warrior hidden within an egg that attacks enemies by flinging eggshells.

name: The Shadow Who Controls the Dark
desc: A living shadow that dwells in the realm of darkness. It paralyzes its enemies to prevent attacks.

name: Lord of the Lamp
desc: A giant that appears from a mystic lamp and follows the orders of the lamp's owner.

name: Akihiron
desc: A mysterious creature that dwells below the sea.

name: Rhaimundos of the Red Sword
desc: A warrior armed with the Sword of Crimson Flames. Uses fire to bind the movement of its enemies.

name: The Melting Red Shadow
desc: A creature that melts into the earth, melds with an opponent's shadow, and attacks from below.

name: Dokuroizo the Grim Reaper
desc: A living spirit that preys on the living essence of enemies.

name: Fire Reaper
desc: A creature that deals out punishment with its flaming arrows.

name: Larvas
desc: A fast-moving, bird-like creature that strangles an opposing monster with its long, thin arms.

name: Hard Armor
desc: A living suit of armor that attacks enemies with a bone-jarring tackle.

name: Firegrass
desc: A fire-breathing plant found growing near volcanoes.

name: Man Eater
desc: Man-eating plant with poison feelers for attacking enemies.

name: Dig Beak
desc: Coiling its serpent-like body, this creature spins and attacks with its snapping beak.

name: M-warrior #1
desc: Specializing in combination attacks, this warrior uses magnetism to block an enemy's escape.

name: M-warrior #2
desc: Specializing in combination attacks, this warrior is equipped with a tough, magnetically coated armor.

name: Tainted Wisdom
desc: A parasite brain that preys on the knowledge and intelligence of its opponents.

name: Lisark
desc: An unusual creature with sapphire eyes that creates visions to confuse the enemy.

name: Lord of Zemia
desc: A vile entity that deceives enemies into walking a path of destruction.

name: The Judgement Hand
desc: The hand of final judgment is capable of intense attacks against the enemy.

name: Mysterious Puppeteer
desc: A puppet master that manipulates enemies during battle.

name: Ancient Jar
desc: A fragile jar from the past containing a mysterious creature.

name: Darkfire Dragon
desc: Scorching flames that wipe out enemies in the blink of an eye.

name: Dark King of the Abyss
desc: King of the netherworld. It's said that he once had the power to rule over the Dark.

name: Spirit of the Harp
desc: A spirit that soothes the soul with the music of its glorious harp.

name: Big Eye
desc: This creature is covered with hypnotic eyes for mesmerizing its enemies.

name: Armaill
desc: A strange warrior who manipulates three fearsome blades with both hands and its tail.

name: Dark Prisoner
desc: This creature manipulates light to eliminate all traces of its appearance.

name: Hurricail
desc: A twister that runs rampant in the wastelands, cutting its enemies with blades of wind.

name: Ancient Brain
desc: Exiled from reality, this creature is adept at fighting in the dark.

name: Fire Eye
desc: A winged eye enveloped in flames that attacks enemies with fire.

name: Monsturtle
desc: A vicious turtle with a spiked shell.

name: Claw Reacher
desc: Stretching arms and razor-sharp claws make this monster a formidable opponent.

name: Phantom Dewan
desc: A wizard that freezes an enemy's movement with a single curse.

name: Arlownay
desc: A maiden in the flower blossoms spreads poisonous pollen against opponents.

name: Dark Shade
desc: Emits a dazzling light from its crystal to blind its enemies.

name: Masked Clown
desc: A dancing warrior that makes mincemeat out of opponents with a sharp scythe.

name: Lucky Trinket
desc: A thin and reedy creature protected by sacred power.

name: Genin
desc: Uses amazing sleight-of-hand to fool and destroy its enemies.

name: Eyearmor
desc: This warrior confuses and destroys enemies by adopting their images.

name: Fiend Refrection #2
desc: A bird-beast that summons reinforcements with a hand mirror.

name: Gate Deeg
desc: A creature with an abdominal portal used for summoning monsters from the netherworld.

name: Synchar
desc: An ugly creature with two heads and a mouth for blasting laser beams.

name: Fusionist
desc: A monstrous cat with wings and a long, striking tail.

name: Akakieisu
desc: A wizard whose incantations numb the senses of opposing monsters.

name: LaLa Li-oon
desc: Protected by thunder, this dangerous cloud attacks its enemies with acid rain.

name: Key Mace
desc: A small angel whose cuteness melts the hearts of its enemies.

name: Turtle Tiger
desc: A tiger encased in a protective shell that attacks its enemies with its razor-sharp fangs.

name: Terra the Terrible
desc: Know as a dweller of the swamps, this creature is a minion of the Dark forces.

name: Doron
desc: An unpredictable creature that splits into two and attacks an enemy from opposite directions.

name: Arma Knight
desc: An ammonite warrior that has protected the seas from the dawn of time.

name: Mech Mole Zombie
desc: A creature of the night that attacks enemies with its rocket-powered arms.

name: Happy Lover
desc: A little angel that fires beams of happiness from the heart jewel on its forehead.

name: Penguin Knight
desc: A penguin-like creature that slides on its belly to deliver a blow with its outstretched sword.

name: Petit Dragon
desc: A very small dragon known for its vicious attacks.

name: Frenzied Panda
desc: A savage beast that carries a big bamboo stick for beating down its enemies.

name: Air Marmot of Nefariousness
desc: A horned beaver with wings that throws high-velocity acorns from the sky with uncanny accuracy.

name: Phantom Ghost
desc: Malicious spirits that walk the world of the living, unable to find their final resting place.

name: Mabarrel
desc: A cannon-like monster that rapidly fires eyeballs at the enemy.

name: Dorover
desc: An ugly, melting creature that breathes out poison gas.

name: Twin Long Rods #1
desc: This creature swings its whip-like arms for mid-range attacks against enemies.

name: Droll Bird
desc: With a battle cry that curdles the blood of its opponent, this creature attacks with its massive beak.

name: Petit Angel
desc: A quick-moving and tiny angel that's very difficult to hit.

name: Winged Cleaver
desc: This creature attacks by swinging around its sickle-like arms.

name: Hinotama Soul
desc: An intensely hot flame creature that rams anything that stands in its way.

name: Kaminarikozou
desc: This creature stores lightning within its body to deliver electrifying attacks.

name: Meotoko
desc: A huge monster with a single eye that fires an intence beam.

name: Aqua Madoor
desc: A wizard of the waters that conjures a liquid wall to crush any enemies that oppose him.

name: Kagemusha of the Blue Flame
desc: Serves as a double for the ruler of the Blue Flame. A master swordsman that wields a fine blade.

name: Flame Ghost
desc: A fiery spirit that burns anything in its path.

name: Dryad
desc: A spirit of the forest protected by the surrounding plant life.

name: B. Skull Dragon
desc: A very rare creature created from the fusion of an uncommon beast and a vicious dragon.

name: Two-mouth Darkruler
desc: A dinosaur with two crushing jaws. Stores electricity in its horn and releases high voltage bolts from the mouth on its back.

name: Solitude
desc: A beast-warrior that swings a massive scythe that draws on the spirit of its enemies to deliver devastating blows.

name: Masked Sorcerer
desc: A mysterious wizard whose face remains forever hidden behind a strange mask.

name: Kumootoko
desc: A massive, intelligent spider that traps its enemies with webbing.

name: Midnight Fiend
desc: A winged creature rumored to appear at midnight.

name: Roaring Ocean Snake
desc: A massive sea serpent that creates tidal waves to wipe out its enemies.

name: Trap Master
desc: A warrior that excels in laying traps such as a bottomless pit, for eternally ensnaring opponents.

name: Fiend Sword
desc: Few have escaped the curse of this creature. Those that have done so have gained untold power.

name: Skull Stalker
desc: Swift and vicious, this monster grabs its victim with its pincers and attacks the captive with its poison stinger.

name: Hitodenchak
desc: A vicious starfish that spits acid to melt away its enemies.

name: Wood Remains
desc: A zombie that rose from the remains of the woodland ruler.

name: Hourglass of Life
desc: A creature that allows power to be gained at the cost of life.

name: Rare Fish
desc: An unusual and ferocious fish with the head of a beast.

name: Wood Clown
desc: An unpleasantly smiling creature that wields a scythe to avoid enemy blows.

name: Madjinn Gunn
desc: A living weapon that fires projectiles from its mouth.

name: Dark Titan of Terror
desc: A spirit said to dwell in the world of dreams. Attacks enemies in their sleep.

name: Beautiful Headhuntress
desc: A lovely swordmaster with some very agile moves.

name: Wodan the Resident of the Forest
desc: A warrior that has long resided in the forest and enjoys the protection of Mother Nature.

name: Guardian of the Labyrinth
desc: A warrior that guards the entrance to the netherworld.

name: Haniwa
desc: An earthen doll that protects the treasure in the tombs of ancient kings.

name: Yashinoki
desc: A palm tree with a will of its own that attacks enemies by flinging coconuts.

name: Vishwar Randi
desc: A woman warrior that serves the forces of darkness.

name: The Drdek
desc: An eyeball creature with legs for jumping high and delivering finishing blows with its sharp claws.

name: Dark Assailant
desc: Armed with Psycho Sword, this sinister cutthroat rules the outer land.

name: Candle of Fate
desc: An opponent's fate is decided when the flames of each finger are extinguished.

name: Water Element
desc: A water spirit that envelops its opponent in a thick fog to cover its attack.

name: Dissolverock
desc: A monster borne from the lava pits. Generates intensive heat that can melt away its enemies.

name: Meda Bat
desc: An eyeball fiend created by a servant of darkness. Uses "Dark Spheres" to blow away its enemies.

name: One Who Hunts Souls
desc: A creature with a sword that gains its power from the life forces of its victims.

name: Root Water
desc: An amphibian capable of calling up a massive tidal wave from the dark seas to wipe out enemy monsters.

name: Master & Expert
desc: A fearsome duo consisting of a beast master and its loyal servant.

name: Water Omotics
desc: Transforms the water overflowing from a jar into attacking dragons.

name: Hyo
desc: An ice warrior whose slightest touch freezes an opponent.

name: Enchanting Mermaid
desc: A beautiful mermaid that lures voyagers to a watery grave.

name: Nekogal #1
desc: A cat creature that looks cute to the eye but delivers scratching blows with its sharp claws.

name: Angelwitch
desc: A creature that chose the path of sorcery to become a witch.

name: Embryonic Beast
desc: A repulsive monster with a gaping belly that swallows almost anything.

name: Prevent Rat
desc: This monster is shielded by a hide covered in thick hair.

name: Dimensional Warrior
desc: A monster capable of creating dimensional rifts to trap its enemies.

name: Stone Armadiller
desc: With a body armored by rock-hard fur, this monster features excellent defense capabilities.

name: Beastking of the Swamps
desc: This creature changes the ground at its feet into quicksand to ensnare its enemies.

name: Ancient Sorcerer
desc: A master fighter that uses various staffs to render enemies unconscious.

name: Lunar Queen Elzaim
desc: A lovely moon goddess that can throw up a lunar curtain to block enemy attacks.

name: Wicked Mirror
desc: A malevolent mirror that hypnotizes a beholder and renders the victim susceptible to attacks.

name: The Little Swordsman of Aile
desc: An elf warrior mounted on a huge lizard.

name: Rock Ogre Grotto #2
desc: A stone golem that turns opponents into rocks and crushes them to dust.

name: Wing Egg Elf
desc: Hiding within its eggshell, this creature blocks enemy attacks with its massive wings.

name: The Furious Sea King
desc: Grand King of the Seven Seas. Able to summon massive tidal waves to drown the enemy.

name: Princess of Tsurugi
desc: A queen of swords that is virtually unequalled in her mastery of every blade imaginable to man.

name: Unknown Warrior of Fiend
desc: The speed of this warrior creates an intense vacuum that can actually slice through a monster's hide.

name: Sectarian of Secrets
desc: A sorcerer that worships the dark forces and can summon a massive hand to drag away opponents into the netherworld.

name: Versago the Destroyer
desc: A lord of destruction born from the heart of darkness, this creature can summon storms to destroy opponents.

name: Wetha
desc: A rain spirit that can summon typhoons to blow away its enemies.

name: Megirus Light
desc: This creature's ominous eyes can unleash piercing rays against its enemies.

name: Mavelus
desc: Related to the phoenix, this creature dwells in the mountains. Its fiery breath is extremely scorching.

name: Ancient Tree of Enlightenment
desc: Armed with a wealth of knowledge, this monster is able to block just about any attack.

name: Green Phantom King
desc: This youthful king of the forests lives in a green world, abundant with trees and wildlife.

name: Ground Attacker Bugroth
desc: A land-based armored robot that is said to once have marine attack capabilities.

name: Ray & Temperature
desc: The Sun and the North Wind join hands to deliver a devastating combination of heat and gale-force winds.

name: Gorgon Egg
desc: A gorgon's egg with eyes said to create whatever creature crosses its view.

name: Petit Moth
desc: Nobody has any idea what creature may spawn from this mysterious larva.

name: King Fog
desc: A spectre that dwells in a blinding curtain of smoke.

name: Protector of the Throne
